svg.title: Build the second strand
svg.desc: Each full turn is one release round. A held attempt never counts as released. A release meets fresh, matching evidence and existing release authority. Monitoring overlaps the next turn.
svg.text: A migration for teams with existing delivery, manual QA and Selenium.
Start with one reversible change. Keep the existing release process during the pilot.
Each full turn is one release round. A held attempt never counts as released.
Throughout each turn: challenge · verify / validate · feed back · retest / regress · release / observe
A release meets fresh, matching evidence and existing release authority. Monitoring overlaps the next turn.
